title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: First-page Technologies inventory, validated from Randstad's full job descriptions. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Rechecked October 5, 2026 — direct HTTP 200 on the Technologies category (first page, 30 postings, 385 Ontario / 44 Québec of the full list). No SRE, Platform, DevOps, Cloud or DevSecOps postings on the page; 1 infrastructure-architect listing scored out of scope. 0 filed.

notes_sections.heading: October 5 audit
items: Fetched https://www.randstad.ca/jobs/s-technologies/ (HTTP 200, no CAPTCHA) and filtered the first page locally; no JobPosting JSON-LD was exposed this run, so postings were read from the static listing HTML (titles, locations, IDs only — descriptions not opened). Titles on the page are dominated by software developers, Maximo/CRM analysts, project and change managers, scrum masters and retail coffee roles. The only infrastructure-flavoured listing is Infrastructure Architect and Partner – MSP Experience (Saint-Laurent, QC), which is an architect/partner role. Not paginated (the first page held postings from the past ~2 weeks and nothing in the target families).

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Reviewed all 30 postings on the first Technologies category page (535 total jobs in the category this run), dated September 18-22, 2026; retrieved via direct HTTP fetch of the embedded Elasticsearch search-results payload in the page's window.__ROUTE_DATA__ block — every listed job's title, city, date, salary band, and description snippet inspected, not just the visible cards. No pagination requested.

Category composition this run skews even harder toward Business/Systems Analyst, Project Manager, Enterprise/Solution Architect, SAP Functional Analyst, QA/SDET, and unrelated retail roles (two Nespresso/coffee-kiosk postings) than prior runs — almost no DevOps/SRE/Platform signal at all.

Only 3 of the 30 postings plausibly centered on this search's scope after title/description screening: Production Support Specialist (unchanged from the 2026-09-21 run, same job ID, still live — Toronto hybrid, outside the reachable-city range), Performance Engineer (Mississauga, hybrid 2 days/week on-site — JMeter/Dynatrace performance-tuning role with real infra flavor, but Mississauga is outside the reachable-city range), and Security Developer - Remote (Alberta financial client, fully remote — but the actual center of gravity is offensive security/penetration testing and red-team operations, not DevSecOps engineering; ruled out on domain, not geography).

The four postings scored in the 2026-09-21 run that are not in today's inventory (Systems Integrator, Lead Full Stack Developer, Mainframe Production Support Specialist, Security Specialist V) have rotated out of the first category page — none had an applications.md row, so nothing to reconcile there.

The previously Applied DevOps Specialist — REMOTE posting (applications.md, Applied 2026-09-16) remains confirmed Expired per the 2026-09-19 run and is not part of today's first-page inventory; no status change made in applications.md.
All retrieval was read-only via direct HTTP fetch with a standard browser user-agent; no application, email, profile, account, or form action was used.

rows.title: Production Support Specialist (Client Connectivity & Payments)
rows.gap: Real SRE/production-support center of gravity — incident management, RCA, monitoring/observability (Splunk, AppDynamics, Geneos), ITIL — but Toronto hybrid is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal); not take-able.

rows.title: Performance Engineer
rows.gap: 12-month contract with strong potential extension/conversion; JMeter load testing, Dynatrace deep-dive diagnostics, system/database tuning — genuine infra-adjacent performance-engineering work. Mississauga hybrid is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal); not take-able.

rows.title: Security Developer - Remote
rows.gap: Fully remote and Canada-eligible on paper, but the role is offensive-security work — hands-on penetration testing, red-team operations, crisis-simulation/tabletop facilitation, third-party pentest vendor governance — not DevSecOps engineering. Wrong domain center of gravity; also well below Marc's rate floor.

rows.title: Infrastructure Architect and Partner – MSP Experience
rows.gap: Architect/partner role for a managed-services provider — architecture-first scope, not hands-on reliability or platform engineering; judged from the listing, description not opened
